result.rationale: The diff shows `before_validation do self.host.sub!(/^https?:\//, '') ... end` in embeddable_host.rb with no nil guard, while `validates_format_of :host` would only reject nil after validation callbacks run. The controller's `save_host` does `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]`, so a POST omitting that param yields nil host and `sub!` raises NoMethodError, producing a 500 instead of a 422 validation error. Mechanism verified from the diff.

judged_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:6 — `self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` in `before_validation` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'sub!' for nil` whenever `host` is nil (API/curl POST to /admin/embeddable_hosts without `embeddable_host[host]`, which line 23 of the controller assigns straight from `params[:embeddable_host][:host]`), turning what `validates_format_of :host` would report as a 422 validation error into a 500 (severity P3, confidence 75, advisory)
